title: R&D
description: Research, technical studies, and feasibility validation.
tasks: Research AR-15 part compatibility.
Research and define AR-15 part categories.
Gather and review technical references for parts and components.

title: Prototyping
description: Proof of concept, technology integration, and core workflow validation.
tasks: Integrate Sketchfab with Cloudflare R2 to support a larger number of configurable parts and overcome asset-loading limitations.
Test basic 3D interactions, including showing and hiding parts, repositioning components, and swapping textures.
Develop a preliminary database system using Supabase. The database provider may be changed later.
Test basic Shopify integration, including product stock retrieval, price retrieval, and payment flow testing.

title: Initial Data Sorting
description: Reviewing and selecting eligible products for the configurator.
tasks: Review the available product and parts inventory.
Identify and sort parts that are suitable for inclusion in the configurator.
Exclude parts that are not relevant to the current configurator scope.

title: Part Categorization
description: Organizing selected parts into structured product categories.
tasks: Group the previously sorted parts into appropriate categories.
Organize component groups such as barrels, handguards, and other relevant categories.
Establish an initial categorization structure for the configurator.

title: Configurator Creation (Front-End Only)
description: Developing the interactive configurator, 3D assets, and user interface.
tasks: Validate the previously sorted parts inventory.
Review and validate the part categorization structure.
Validate the part compatibility logic.
Create and optimize 3D models for web-based rendering.
Design and develop the configurator UX/UI.
Upload texture assets to cloud storage.
Integrate cloud-hosted textures into the configurator.
Additional tasks are currently under consideration.

title: Polishing
description: Refining the configurator interface, 3D models, and visual quality.
tasks: Develop a database structure for storing material properties, including metalness and roughness values.
Integrate the stored material properties into the 3D visualization workflow to improve metallic material appearance.
Refine and polish the configurator UX/UI.
Improve and polish 3D model presentation in Sketchfab.

title: Shopify Integration
description: Developing management tools and connecting the configurator to a Shopify test store.
tasks: Develop a dedicated configurator management dashboard.
Implement controls to enable or disable individual parts within the configurator.
Add basic website traffic and visitor statistics to the management dashboard.
Prepare a Shopify test store for integration testing.
Integrate the configurator with Shopify using the appropriate public Storefront API access mechanism.
Build upon the stock retrieval, pricing, and payment flow prototypes validated during Milestone 02.
Additional dashboard features are still under consideration.

title: Configurator Testing
description: Testing the configurator's features and overall functionality before production deployment.
tasks: Test the configurator's core functionality.
Validate part selection and compatibility behavior.
Test 3D model loading and interaction.
Check interface usability and responsiveness.
Identify and resolve issues before live-store integration.

title: Live Store Integration
description: Migrating the configurator from the test environment to the live Shopify store.
tasks: Connect the configurator to the actual Shopify store.
Replace test-store configuration with production-store configuration.
Verify product, variant, stock, and pricing data against the live store.
Validate the configurator's connection to the live shopping workflow.

title: Final Integration Testing
description: Performing final end-to-end testing before the official launch.
tasks: Perform final end-to-end configurator and Shopify integration testing.
Verify product selection and cart or checkout workflows.
Validate live product data synchronization.
Perform final usability and functional checks.
Resolve critical integration issues before launch.
Confirm launch readiness.
